impact: The originally reported clipping was reproduced only with Chrome `--window-size=390`, which uses a 500px layout viewport in headless Chrome and crops the screenshot. With CDP device metrics set to a true 390x844 mobile viewport, `/`, `/projects`, `/resume`, `/blog`, and `/blog/hello-world` all report document/body scroll widths of 390px with no real horizontal page overflow.
resolution: Resolved as a verification artifact. True 390px mobile viewport checks show the affected routes fit within the viewport; the only offscreen element detected is the intentionally hidden skip link. No layout code change required.
title: Mobile routes horizontally overflow and clip content
